title: Elderly Woman in Floral Hat & Print Dress, 1957 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp, full-length black-and-white snapshot from November 1957 capturing a stylish senior woman standing outdoors along a brick garden pathway next to a stucco house. She is dressed in typical mid-century Sunday best or social attire, wearing a patterned dress with a matching jacket, dark-rimmed cat-eye glasses, a crown of floral decorations atop her styled hair, white gloves, and carrying an ornately carved, tooled leather handbag. The bright afternoon sun casts a deep shadow across the manicured brickwork and ivy beds.
